notes: offerings of Jehovah made by fire divides between אִשֶּׁה and the divine name, the אִשֶּׁה unit discontinuous under rule 25 and headed on fire; the competing head on offerings is named in the unit's note.
most holy: קֹדֶשׁ holds holy with the verbless clause's copula and the intensifying rectum קָדָשִׁים holds most (rules 19, 20).
Both attributive articles (s014, s020) are rendered by relatives under rule 41, each participle keeping its own English with any supplied copula.
